metadata.title: A proof of the Willmore-type conjecture in $\mathbb{C}P^2$
metadata.abstract: In 2002, Montiel and Urbano conjectured that the Clifford torus in $\mathbb{C}P^2$ minimizes the Willmore-type functional $ \mathcal{W}^-=\int_{T^2}(2+|H|^2)\,dA,$ either among all tori or among all Lagrangian tori. In this paper, we confirm this conjecture in the Lagrangian setting and disprove it in the general setting. We establish that every oriented closed Lagrangian surface of genus $g\geq 1$ in $\mathbb{C}P^2$ has $\mathcal{W}^-$-energy no less than that of the Clifford torus. Moreover, we construct non-Lagrangian deformations of the Clifford torus along which $\mathcal{W}^-$ strictly decreases.
metadata.comment: 24 pages, 2 figures, All comments are welcome!

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: CP² 中 Willmore 型猜想的分界
analysis.workSummary: 证明亏格至少一的定向闭 Lagrangian 曲面 W⁻ 能量不低于 Clifford 环面，同时构造非 Lagrangian 变形使其能量下降。
analysis.breakthrough: 确认 Montiel–Urbano 猜想的 Lagrangian 版本，并否定一般版本。
analysis.limitations: 必须区分 Lagrangian 限制与任意环面；不能笼统称所有版本均被证明。
analysis.priorityReason: 确认 Montiel–Urbano 猜想的 Lagrangian 版本，并否定一般版本。
